newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian January construction works up 55 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Croatian January construction works up 55 pct y/y.

text.p: The value of construction works in Croatia rose to 343.3 million kuna in January, or 55 percent from the same month last year, the State Statistics Bureau reported on Wednesday.
Official statistics gave no monthly change from December.
The agreed value of building contracts for this year was put at 2.6 billion kuna, compared to 1.6 billion in 1996.
Of the 1997 total, some 2.3 billion works were expected to be completed before the end of the year or 58 percent more than in 1996.

A total of 23,910 or 18 percent more builders were employed at construction sites in January, compared to January 1996. But they put in just 10 percent more working hours or 3.5 million. These figures exclude engineers and technicians. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
